81 FIRSTAMENDMENTTO ZONINGLOT DEVELOPMENT ANDEASEMENT AGREEMENT THISFIRST AMENDMENT TO ZONING LOTDEVELOPMENT ANDEASEMENT AGREEMENT made as of this 2/ day of August, 2019 (this “Agreement"), by and between EAST 149TH REALTY CORP. ("Realty"), a New York corporation having an address at 1112 Park Avenue, Unit 3A,New York, New York 10128, RIVER AVENUE MANAGEMENT, LLC, ("RAM"), RAM EXTERIOR LLC, ("Exterior LLC"), RAM HOUSING LLC ("Housing LLC"), RAM HOUSING LIHTC LLC ("LIHTC LLC"), each a New York limited liability company, and each having an address at c/o Monadnock Construction, 153 3rd Street, Brooklyn, New York 11231，SAMARITAN-EXTERIOR HOUSING DEVELOPMENT FUND DEVELOPMENT FUND CORPORATION ("Gerard HDFC") each a New York not-for-profit corporation, and each having an address at 138-02 Queens Boulevard, Briarwood, New York 11435. RECITALS A. Realty and RAM are parties to that certain Zoning Lot Development and Easement Agreement dated December 28, 2015 and recorded in the Office of the City Register of the City of New York, Bronx County (the “Register's Office") as City Register File Number ("CRFN") 2016000016727 on January 19, 2016 (the “ZLDA"). B. Capitalized terms used but not defined herein, shall have the respective meanings given to them in theZLDA. C. Realty is the owner in fee title of certain land, with the buildings and/or improvements thereon, commonly known as 530 Exterior Street, Bronx, New York,and identified on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Bronx County (the“Tax Map") as Block 2351,Lot 25,which is more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto (collectively, the“Exterior Parcel"). D. Realty is also the owner in fee title of certain land, with the buildings and/or improvements thereon, commonly known as 110 East 149th Street, Bronx, New York, and identified on the Tax Map as Block 2351, Lot 40, which is more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto (collectively, the “Lot 40 Parcel"). E. Realty is also the owner in fee title of certain land, with the buildings and/or improvements thereon, commonly known as 491 Gerard Avenue, Bronx, New York, and identified on the Tax Map as Block 2351, Lots 1101 and 1102 (f/k/a Lot 50), which is more particularly described in Exhibit C annexed hereto (collectively, the “Gerard Parcel"). F.  Pursuant to the ZLDA, it was anticipated that RAM and its successors or assigns would further develop the Exterior Parcel, the Lot 40 Parcel, and the Gerard Parcel.
